messages:
maria.chavez: We need more visible runtime telemetry for kernel selection decisions. Today it's basically opaque and it makes debugging regressions a pain.
akshay: Agree. Can we log the kernel id + a short reason code whenever selection happens? e.g. 'kernel=f_flash_v2 reason=seq_len_bucket_512 hw=A100 perf_est_ms=1.2'
tim_s: +1. Also include the seq_len_bucket and whether kv-cache path was used. We saw different perf on warm vs cold KV cache.
perfbot: [automation] regression alert: canary cluster a100-eu shows +12% p99 token latency for model: rw-7b-seq1024 on 2026-03-02. Suspected kernel fallback to aten_attn at seq_len>512.
jen: Is that the autotune picking aten_attn due to throughput estimate? We should capture the autotune inputs (batch size distribution, seq len histogram, hw_arch, free_mem_gb).
david.l: Example of what I'd like in the logs: JSON blob per-request (sampled):
```
{"t":1748501234, "req_id":"r_abc123", "model":"rw-7b","kernel":"flash_v2","kernel_id":"k_flash_v2_v1","selected_reason":"est_latency","seq_len":768,"seq_len_bucket":"512-1024","hw_arch":"ampere_a100","batch_size":4,"kv_cache_hit":true,"perf_est_ms":0.95,"perf_profile_samples":[0.9,0.96,0.98]}
```
akshay: That is perfect. We should also include a compact "decision_trace" array for debugging autotune: e.g. ["candidate:flash_v2 est:0.95","candidate:aten_attn est:1.2","picked:flash_v2"]
maria.chavez: Add a debug env flag to increase sampling rate: REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 or REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=sampling:100. And a scoped toggle per-deployment via console.
sophia: Heads up: must be careful about cardinality in logs. kernel_id + hw_arch + seq_len_bucket is OK, but don't include full prompt text or KV contents. Mask sensitive fields.
jen: Also capture whether the selected kernel uses the fused gelu path or fallback aten gelu — that's been a source of perf variance on newer cuda libs. Maybe kernel_tags: ["fused_gelu","fp16_q4"]
david.l: For sequence-length-dependent paths we should emit a small histogram per minute for the model+deployment to drive offline autotune improvements. Something like: {"buckets": {"0-64": 12000, "65-256": 3400, "257-512": 800, "512-1024": 200}}
akshay: Implementation note: instrument selection code in kernel_selector.cc; emit a sampled line on RTV log channel and a structured event to metrics pipeline (kafka). Make sure the event schema is versioned (v1, v2).
perfbot: [data] example telemetry event received: {model:rw-7b, kernel:aten_attn, reason:overhead_threshold, seq_bucket:1024+, hw:ampere_a100, sample_rate:1/100} :eyes:
tim_s: For autotune, we should log reason codes like: est_latency, est_throughput, memory_constraint, compatibility_fallback, user_override. Keep them limited so alerts can aggregate on them.
maria.chavez: We also want a lightweight debug flag that forces selection logging for every canary request: REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=force_log. Use only in short windows.
sophia: To help postmortems, include the code-version and git-sha used by kernel_selector module in telemetry. And the kernel binary build hash.
jen: Small UX ask: in the console show the last 24h breakdown by kernel_id with stack bars and an option to filter seq_len buckets. That will speed up RCA. :thumbsup:
david.l: One more: log if KV cache forced a long-path (cache_miss=true) vs cache_hit — that changes memory pressure and kernel choice.
maria.chavez: I'll draft a telemetry spec and schema and post it here by EOD. Then we can sync on the minimal fields to start (v1). Thanks everyone. :rocket:
